explorer.whenToUse: Use for fast read-only repository mapping before another specialist acts.

docs_researcher.whenToUse: Use for current primary-source framework, library, API, or standards research; pick this over explorer when external documentation is required.

product_designer.whenToUse: Use for feature shaping, Figma inspection, interaction states, accessibility, and design-system decisions before UI implementation.

storefront_engineer.whenToUse: Use for approved Next.js storefront, semantic token, shadcn primitive, Storybook, Vitest, and Playwright implementation in an isolated Treehouse worktree.

content_commerce_engineer.whenToUse: Use for Sanity schemas and content flows or the server-side Shopify boundary in an isolated Treehouse worktree.

quality_reviewer.whenToUse: Use for an independent post-implementation review of correctness, security, accessibility, design drift, and missing tests.

browser_release_debugger.whenToUse: Use for Playwright journeys, Vercel Preview verification, deployment failures, and incident evidence without production mutation.
